subject: Tufts University Tennis Courts Proposal
overview: Tufts University held a pre-application community meeting to present its proposal to construct eight new tennis courts on Field A along College Avenue in Medford. University representatives and project designers detailed site plans, lighting spill mitigation, and public access before answering questions from local residents.

items.title: Introduction and Proposal Overview
items.summary: Rocco DiRico opened the meeting and outlined the plan to construct eight new tennis courts on Field A across from Cousins Gym to replace former courts repurposed for student housing.

items.title: Athletic Department Remarks
items.summary: Athletic Director John Morris discussed the benefits of consolidating varsity tennis with adjacent sports facilities and confirmed that the courts will be available for Medford community use.

items.title: Project Design Overview
items.summary: Project Manager Jen Whitney presented site plans for the eight concrete acrylic courts, scoreboards, spectator seating, and perimeter landscaping.

items.title: Lighting Spill Analysis
items.summary: Architect John Hickok explained how programmable LED light fixtures will minimize light spillage compared to the existing recreational lighting on Field A.

items.title: Project Timeline and Community Q&A
items.summary: Panelists reviewed the construction schedule targeting completion by June 2023 and answered resident questions regarding lighting controls, pedestrian gate access, construction impacts, stormwater drainage, and tree screening.
